free_tier.stated: No free IPv4 lease. The platform subscription has a Free plan at $0 ('Try the platform - free forever'), but 'IPXO platform subscriptions and IPv4 leasing are priced separately.' The 3x3 campaign rate for leased space is $0.25 per IP per month on a minimum 3-year term; the platform's yearly average lease rate is $0.38 per IP per month.
free_tier.notes: The Free subscription gives access to the platform's resource view and pay-as-you-go tokens; it carries no address space. A published per-subnet price list is not on the pages read: the pricing page says 'IPv4 leasing prices depend on the IP block size, lease term, and available inventory', and the search that shows each subnet's monthly price sits behind the portal sign-up.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address block, not an object; the smallest block is a /24 (256 IPs)
per_object_cap.notes: The 3x3 campaign terms state 'Minimum block size: /24 (256 IPs). No subnet size limitations apply above the minimum.' No smaller block is offered under those terms.

retention.stated: not applicable: a leased block, not stored bytes; campaign terms are a 3-year minimum and 10-year maximum
retention.notes: Campaign billing is annual in advance, and early exit is not permitted: the remaining annual fees for the full term fall due. Terms shorter than 3 years are quoted by sales at a different rate.

egress.terms: not applicable: IPXO sells the right to announce an address block, not a carrier port. The lessee announces the block from its own ASN or through a cloud's bring-your-own-IP feature; traffic is billed by that network, not by IPXO.
egress.free_allowance: not applicable: no traffic is carried by the vendor

interface_detail: A web portal handles search, lease, LOA, ROA, WHOIS and rDNS ('Assign IPs immediately with automated LOA, ROA, and WHOIS updates.'); the site's navigation lists 'API Access: Automate IP search and leasing workflows'. The API's endpoints and authentication were not read.
tooling: A BGP speaker, a cloud's bring-your-own-IP service or a hoster that announces the block for the lessee; IPXO issues the LOA and ROA and keeps WHOIS and rDNS in sync. The leasing page advertises 'Deploy IPXO-leased IPs across major platforms at lower cost.'
chaining: A leased /24 is 256 addresses in one prefix, one registry object and one announcing AS, so for a rotating egress it is one rung-3 unit with 256 source addresses; the lease supplies address space and no machine. The registry class of a delivered IPXO block is unverified: a delivered block needs a confirmed company account, so no registry object of a leased block was read.

limits.value: smallest lease unit is a /24 (256 IPs): 'Minimum block size: /24 (256 IPs).' Campaign term minimum 3 years, maximum 10 years, billed annually in advance

limits_note: The vocabulary has no kind for a minimum purchase size or a contract term; volume-quota is the nearest and is used for the /24 minimum. A second gate is not a limit at all: the account must be a legal entity acting in the course of business, and a leased block is announced from an ASN the lessee names. The $0.25 per IP per month rate applies only to the campaign's 3-year terms.
binding_note: The /24 minimum binds first on the price side: 256 addresses at the campaign rate, and a 3-year commitment, are the smallest purchase. Identity binds before any of it (legal entities only, with company confirmation by support), which is why the verdict is fails-identity; the limit vocabulary has no kind for that.

identity_cost.detail: A payment method (credit card, PayPal or wire transfer) is added after that. The terms describe a 'basic Know Your Customer (KYC) process'.

reliability_note: unverified: no delivered block was inspected, because leasing needs a confirmed company account and a payment method; the registry object and usage class of a leased /24 are behind that sign-up.
confidence_note: Per-subnet prices, the API reference and the registry object of a delivered block are unverified: behind a company sign-up.

extras.role: marketplace between address holders and lessees; the lessee's blocks are sub-allocated from the holder's registry object
extras.price_per_address_month: USD 0.25 on the 3-year campaign; USD 0.38 is the vendor's platform average
extras.price_derived: USD 0.25 x 256 = USD 64.00 per month for a /24 at the campaign rate; USD 3 x 256 = USD 768 per year; USD 0.38 x 256 = USD 97.28 per month at the stated average, all before VAT
extras.registries: ARIN, RIPE NCC, AFRINIC (the campaign's list)
extras.needs_own_asn: unverified: the portal asks for the ASN where the lease is announced; the page read states 'RPKI, ROA and WHOIS managed by IPXO' and a BYOIP route for each major cloud
extras.rung_note: One /24 is one rung-3 unit; rung 5 is unverified until a delivered block's registry object is read.
